description:
Three places pass mailboxIds without checking that values are true:

1. email.rs:460-464 (Email/set create): mailbox_ids_ok checks !m.is_empty() but not any(v == true). RFC 8621 §5.5.3: 'At least one MUST be set to true.' Fix: m.values().any(|v| v.as_bool() == Some(true)).

2. email.rs:916-917 (Email/import): takes all keys regardless of boolean value; passes false-valued IDs to backend. Fix: filter to only keys with true values.

3. email.rs:1158-1159 (Email/copy): same issue as import.
title: Email/set create: accepts mailboxIds with no true values
